text: A ninja in black, in the shadows.
Nope. Probably not.
Ninjas: the black outfit myth.
Real ninjas, called shinobi, were spies.
A spy's job is to blend in.
So they dressed like everyone else.
Farmers. Merchants. Monks.
A black suit in daylight? Very suspicious.
So where did the black come from?
From the theatre.
In kabuki, the stage crew dressed all in black.
The audience pretended they were invisible.
So when a ninja appeared on stage...
...dressing them like the stage crew was the perfect trick.
Prints and movies copied the look.
And now every ninja wears black.
Real shinobi? Hard to spot. That was the point.
Disguises in old ninja manuals: lots.
Proof they wore black suits: thin.
Anyway, here's a ninja in black.
